xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3926: Herdr gaps: isAliveSync tmux-only callers; swarm concurrency counts tmuxActive; swarmJanitorPass unscheduled

plan.title: Herdr gaps: isAliveSync tmux-only callers; swarm concurrency counts tmuxActive; swarmJanitorPass unscheduled
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5-1

metadata.sizeJustification: Three small, independent Herdr-liveness fixes that share one pattern (read the selected backend's inventory instead of tmux). The file count is dominated by porting ~20 existing test files whose mocks name the deleted sync exports; the production diff touches nine source files. Splitting into sibling issues would triple review overhead for a change the parent issue already scoped as one follow-up.

narratives.Problem: Three places still assume 'alive means has a tmux session', so on a Herdr host (the default since PAN-3917) they are wrong in the direction that matters. (1) isAliveSync in src/lib/agents/liveness.ts is tmux-only; its callers getWorkAgentLifecycleStateSync (work-agent-lifecycle.ts:97) and resolveParkedPopulation (parked/resolver.ts:258) read every healthy Herdr agent as a confirmed no-session death, so pan start/resume/unpause/reset-session, the merge-strike route and the parked sweeper misjudge live agents. (2) countRunningSwarmSlotsForIssue, describeRunningAgents and emergencyBrake in src/lib/cloister/concurrency.ts filter listRunningAgentsSync() rows on tmuxActive, which is false for every live Herdr agent, so swarm dispatch over-admits, diagnostics report an empty box, and the brake trims nothing. (3) swarmJanitorPass (deacon-swarm.ts:353) has had no caller since deacon.ts was deleted, and its default deps are tmux primitives. Swarm is dormant (D11) but the issue requires all three to be backend-aware before it is re-enabled.
narratives.Proposal: Liveness: there is no synchronous Herdr client and the repo forbids new sync primitives, so the sync door is retired rather than patched. Export getWorkAgentLifecycleStateAsync / assertCanStartFreshAsync / assertCanResumeSessionAsync over the existing async snapshot (which already uses backend-aware isAlive), move the six callers (all already inside async functions) to them, switch the parked sweeper to Promise.all over isAlive, then delete isAliveSync, the sync classifier/guards and findAgentRuntimePidInSubtreeSync as orphans. Counts: countRunningSwarmSlotsForIssue takes liveIds: ReadonlySet<string> | null (null fails open like countRunningAgents), an async countLiveSwarmSlotsForIssue wrapper reads listLiveAgentIds(), registeredSlotCapacityAvailable's dep becomes Promise<boolean>; describeRunningAgents and emergencyBrake go async over the same inventory read (the brake stops via the Effect stopAgent). Janitor: a new src/lib/cloister/swarm-janitor.ts runSwarmJanitor() reads liveAgentInventory() once, overrides listSessionNames/isPaneDead/getPaneExitStatus/getPaneOutputDigest on Herdr (only listSessionNames on tmux) on top of the exported defaultCoordinateSwarmDeps, skips on a null inventory, and runs swarmJanitorPass; deacon-lite runs it as a dynamically-imported fifth routine gated off unless a swarm policy mode other than 'off' is configured globally or on any project. Docs: rewrite the known-gap paragraph in docs/TERMINAL-BACKENDS.md and the deacon.ts row in docs/THE-CUT.md. Full detail with before/after snippets is in .pan/drafts/pan-3926.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Renaming the WorkAgentLifecycleState field hasLiveTmuxSession (wired into frontend types and route payloads); its meaning becomes 'the oracle did not confirm death' on either backend.
- Adding a synchronous Herdr probe or any new sync subprocess primitive (prefer-async, no-execsync-server rules).
- Other tmuxActive consumers: memory-governor.ts:450, agents/recovery.ts:360, reconstruct/reconstruct-cache.ts:81, agents/health.ts:141, and listRunningAgentsSync's own tmuxActive computation in agents/queries.ts.
- coordinateSwarmSlots (manual pan swarm) keeping its tmux default deps, and swarm-status.ts's listSessionNamesSync / default classifyInFlightSlots deps — only capacity.used moves to the async count.
- The useSupervisor: true hardcodes in runtimes/muse.ts, runtimes/kimi-code.ts and overdeck/conversation-runtime.ts named in the same docs paragraph (separate Herdr gap).
- Stripping gcOrphanedSlots from swarmJanitorPass to avoid the double GC with sweepOrphanedSwarmSlots (accepted as idempotent, D9).
- Re-enabling swarm: the janitor routine stays dormant under the default policy mode 'off' (D11); no change to pan start's default work path.
- Any change to the Herdr adapter, the inventory module, or hostTerminalBackendName selection.

autoDecisions.summary: Retire the sync liveness door instead of adding a sync Herdr probe.
autoDecisions.rationale: No sync Herdr client exists; prefer-async forbids new sync functions and no-execsync-server forbids a spawnSync of the herdr CLI in a dashboard route (merge-strike.ts). Every caller of the sync classifier is already inside an async function, so the async door is a drop-in.

autoDecisions.summary: Promise variants use the Async suffix; Effect exports keep their names.
autoDecisions.rationale: getWorkAgentLifecycleState is already the Effect export used by five dashboard routes; sendKeysAsync / dropLegacyAgentStatesMissingRoleAsync establish the suffix convention.

autoDecisions.summary: The CLI inherits PAN-3555 owed-rework semantics from the async door.
autoDecisions.rationale: The async snapshot asks the forge only when handedOff is true and a failed forge call already reads false; a handed-off agent with CHANGES_REQUESTED becoming resumable from pan resume is the documented PAN-3555 intent, previously blocked only by the sync door's inability to await.

autoDecisions.summary: emergencyBrake is included although the issue names only two concurrency.ts functions.
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the third tmuxActive filter in the same file with the same Herdr failure (sees zero work agents, trims nothing); leaving it would ship a known gap in the file the issue exists to fix. It also removes a sync tmux kill from a dashboard route.

autoDecisions.summary: The janitor is scheduled from deacon-lite, gated off unless a swarm policy mode other than 'off' is configured.
autoDecisions.rationale: Foreman respawn and stall events are pipeline behavior, which hygiene-scheduler's contract excludes and which must honor the D7 pause; the policy gate keeps PAN-3917 D11/FR-11 dormancy on a default host at zero cost (config reads only).

autoDecisions.summary: The janitor module is imported dynamically from deacon-lite.
autoDecisions.rationale: A static edge would pull spawnRun/messageAgent into the patrol module graph; liveness.ts documents the runtimes cycle this pattern (inventory.ts's await import) avoids.

autoDecisions.summary: Double orphan-slot GC (janitor + hygiene sweep) is accepted.
autoDecisions.rationale: gcOrphanedSlots on a clean slot is a no-op and the janitor is inert by default; stripping it would churn the janitor's existing tests for no behavior gain.

autoDecisions.summary: Parked-sweeper probes run concurrently via Promise.all.
autoDecisions.rationale: A Herdr socket outage then costs one 2 s probe timeout instead of 2 s per running agent.

autoDecisions.summary: Kept as one plan with sizeJustification rather than sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: Nine production files; the rest of the surface is porting test mocks that name the deleted sync exports. The parent issue scoped these three gaps as one follow-up.
